lesson: Reading a kernel together with its character twist does not help: for HEAT, BLS and T-NR the twist commutes with the control's defining operation, so the control pair is the image of (zeta, chi) under one map applied to both members, and functionals homogeneous in each kernel see only monomial distortion (none at all for JC2 without polar terms, Lemma J1). Requiring one sign on (chi, chi') pairs as well cuts the one-signed set fivefold; held-out signs can follow the twisting conductor rather than the class, so held-out positives are essential. Caveats: finite search with lane-defined lifts; most signs float64 (PZ-tier counts not ball-resolved; no ball for the theta^w twist); referee is the author; a 2-core unit overlapped the 16-core unit for about a minute.
